💌 A Special Letter

Dear [Name],

On this special day, I just want to say how much you mean to me. You bring so much happiness into my life, and I am truly grateful for every moment we share.

May your birthday be filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. You deserve nothing but the best today and always.

Happy Birthday once again 🎂💖

Yours sincerely,
[Your Name]
